hypothesis: Uniform independent additive path errors may miss span-dependent uncertainty; compare fixed and train-fitted variance shapes across corridor families before any OD inference.
mean: Zero mean fixed: preceding mean audit favored zero mean in cross-family CV; no background subtraction or GLS scaling fitted here.
covariance: A diag(exp(eta*(zone_span-mean_span)/max_span)) A.T; each road normalized to mean diagonal1, jitter1e-6, one shared profiled variance.
learned_search: 17-point grid on[-4,4], bounded refinement only between neighboring grid points, retain better grid/refinement candidate; training objective only.
validation: Five leave-one-corridor-family folds on public train; freeze full-train models before reporting all supplied validation/private public residuals.
seed: No randomness; fixed four BLAS threads.
scope: Exposed public count-space development diagnostic, not hidden OD validation. Covariance does not identify arbitrary nullspace error; no path candidate produced and official baseline unchanged.
